question.text: SEBI has outlined a Code of Conduct for members of the Investment Committee which includes. Which of the following is NOT a specified duty of IC members?

answer.text: Maintaining integrity and the highest ethical and professional standards of conduct
Disclosing conflicts and recusing from decision making where necessary
Maintaining confidentiality of AIF, investor and investee company information
Personally indemnifying the AIF for any investment losses on approved deals

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the AIF Managers workbook Code of Conduct for Investment Committee members (pp. 313-315), the specified duties are: maintaining integrity and the highest ethical and professional standards of conduct with due care and skill; disclosing conflicts of interest and recusing from decision making where necessary; maintaining confidentiality of AIF, investor and investee company information; and avoiding any act of unethical practice, gross negligence or fraud. Personal indemnification of the AIF for investment losses is not listed in the Code. The Trap: Options A, B and C are explicit items from the Code of Conduct on pp. 313-315. Option D sounds plausible but is not a duty specified by SEBI for IC members in the source. Note: The duties on pp. 313-315 frame the IC's role around standards of conduct, conflict management, confidentiality and avoidance of fraud or gross negligence, rather than outcome guarantees on individual investment decisions.
